commissions.title: 帮楼下奶茶店写个菜单
commissions.description: 店主已经圈好12款饮品和价格，只需要把口味、甜度与过敏原写清楚。沿用现有菜单的短句，不做新品牌设计。比较写作、知识能力与成本，一位合适的伙伴就能开工。
commissions.descriptionEn: The owner has marked 12 drinks and prices. Explain flavours, sweetness and allergens in the existing menu’s short style; no rebrand is requested. Compare writing, knowledge and cost before assigning a teammate.

commissions.title: 修一下网站，就一个小地方
commissions.description: 店主说“付款按钮偶尔没反应”，却发来两种手机截图。先问清复现环境与重复点击的后果，再决定独立修复还是安排审查者复核。
commissions.descriptionEn: The owner says the pay button sometimes does nothing, but sends screenshots from two phones. Clarify reproduction conditions and repeated taps before choosing a solo fix or a reviewed one.

requirements.label: 旧手机也要能提交，补一轮兼容验证
requirements.labelEn: Verify submission on the older phone

requirements.label: 重复点击不能生成两笔订单，补防重检查
requirements.labelEn: Check that repeated taps do not create duplicate orders

proposals.label: 分两阶段交付完整站点
proposals.labelEn: Deliver the full site in two phases

commissions.title: 做个类似微信的简单网站
commissions.description: 负责人拿聊天软件作参考，实际最关心新人找到活动。先澄清两条要求，再比较一次性的小站与分两阶段的完整方案；确认范围后仍需接单。
commissions.descriptionEn: The organiser cites a chat app but needs newcomers to find events. Clarify both requirements, then compare a small one-shot site with a full two-phase plan. Accept after agreeing on scope.

requirements.label: 活动页需要报名入口，补齐表单流程
requirements.labelEn: Add the signup form flow to the event page

requirements.label: 社团干部要更新公告，补交维护说明
requirements.labelEn: Provide instructions for organisers to update announcements

commissions.title: 社团报名页
commissions.description: 社团已提供字段、人数上限和报名成功文案。请按清单完成页面并核对提交逻辑；编码决定主要产出，推理帮助处理边界情况。
commissions.descriptionEn: The club provides fields, capacity and confirmation text. Implement the page and verify submission logic. Coding drives most output; reasoning helps with edge cases.

commissions.title: 备份脚本与恢复演练
commissions.description: 负责人有备份文件，却从未试过恢复。两阶段分别交付备份脚本和恢复演练；先问清演练地点，别把第一阶段结算误当成整个合同结束。
commissions.descriptionEn: The owner has backups but has never restored one. Two phases cover the backup script and recovery drill. Clarify where the drill runs; the first payment does not end the contract.

requirements.label: 在隔离目录演练恢复，补交步骤记录
requirements.labelEn: Record the recovery drill in an isolated directory

commissions.title: 每周生成公司周报
commissions.description: 每周从同一张表生成周报，共三期。字段与格式已经确定，适合稳定的编码搭档；选择前想想后续两期占用的人手和每周账单。
commissions.descriptionEn: Generate a weekly report from the same table for three phases. Fields and format are fixed. Consider the team reserved for later phases and weekly bills before committing.

commissions.title: 咖啡店双语告示
commissions.description: 咖啡店已给出双语术语表，只需整理营业时间、点单步骤与禁烟告示。固定格式不需要创意发挥，适合比较快而省的写作伙伴。
commissions.descriptionEn: The cafe supplies a bilingual glossary for hours, ordering and no-smoking notices. The fixed format needs no creative reinvention; compare fast, economical writers.

commissions.title: 明早的活动致辞
commissions.description: 主持人要在活动前拿到一份能直接朗读的短致辞，交期只有三个工作时段。先确认现场对象，再比较伙伴节律；不要把今晚默认当作工作时段。
commissions.descriptionEn: The host needs a read-aloud speech within three work periods. Clarify the audience and compare teammate rhythms; tonight is not automatically a work period.

requirements.label: 听众包含第一次来访的居民，补背景介绍
requirements.labelEn: Add context for residents attending for the first time

commissions.title: 要温暖又震撼的小故事
commissions.description: 委托人同时说“温暖”和“震撼”，给出的参考却一篇写团聚、一篇写离别。先问清读者与结尾期待，再安排擅长写作且能照顾背景信息的伙伴。
commissions.descriptionEn: The client asks for warmth and impact, with references about reunion and farewell. Clarify the audience and desired ending before assigning a writer who can retain the context.

requirements.label: 读者是刚搬来的小朋友，补充陌生环境的解释
requirements.labelEn: Explain the unfamiliar setting for children who just moved here

requirements.label: 结尾需要保留团聚的希望，补写收束段落
requirements.labelEn: Add a closing passage that preserves hope of reunion

commissions.title: 社区通讯每周更新
commissions.description: 社区通讯每周一期，共三期，沿用同一版式和固定栏目。先确认发布渠道；稳定、低成本的写作比每期重新创作更重要，也要预留后续人手。
commissions.descriptionEn: The community newsletter has three weekly phases with fixed columns and layout. Clarify the publication channel. Steady, economical writing matters more than reinvention; reserve future capacity.

requirements.label: 公告栏与手机群都要发布，补窄屏排版
requirements.labelEn: Prepare a narrow layout for the phone group as well as the noticeboard

commissions.title: 论文引用核查
commissions.description: 研究组已经提供论文和引用清单，要核对结论能否追溯原文。知识与推理同样重要；独立核查节省人手，加入审查者则可补充复核并发现缺陷。
commissions.descriptionEn: The research team provides papers and citations. Check that conclusions trace back to the originals. Knowledge and reasoning both matter; solo work saves staffing, while a reviewer can improve checking and detect defects.

commissions.title: 用户访谈总结
commissions.description: 访谈记录里既有常客也有第一次到店的人，负责人只说“告诉我大家想要什么”。先问清分组与匿名要求，避免把不同人的意见混成一个结论。
commissions.descriptionEn: The interviews mix regular customers and first-time visitors. The owner asks what everyone wants. Clarify grouping and anonymity so distinct needs are not flattened into one conclusion.

requirements.label: 区分常客与新客，补做分组摘要
requirements.labelEn: Add separate summaries for regulars and first-time visitors

requirements.label: 引用须去掉姓名，补匿名核查
requirements.labelEn: Check that quoted comments have names removed

commissions.title: 大订单①：把“像大平台”写成验收单
commissions.titleEn: Big order I: define what “like a platform” means
commissions.description: 孵化器的社区书店想把预约、会员、推荐和在线付款一口气做完。请整理采访记录，列出本次范围、明确排除项和逐条可检查的验收条件。客户先要的是共同理解，不是更多功能。
commissions.descriptionEn: The incubator bookshop asks for bookings, memberships, recommendations and payments at once. Turn interviews into scope, exclusions and testable acceptance criteria. They need shared understanding before more features.

requirements.label: 只覆盖一家门店；会员付款、跨店调货不在本次范围内
requirements.labelEn: One shop only; membership payments and cross-shop stock transfers are excluded

commissions.title: 大订单②：预约系统，两次交付
commissions.titleEn: Big order II: booking system in two deliveries
commissions.description: 第1期交付可演示的预约流程；第2期修正重复预约、时区和取消记录。每期都要验收，等待反馈期间团队仍被合同占用。没有支付、推荐算法或即时聊天，别把“以后可以做”算进这次工期。
commissions.descriptionEn: Phase one demonstrates bookings. Phase two handles duplicates, time zones and cancellations. Both phases require acceptance and retain the team during feedback. Payments, recommendations and chat are excluded.

commissions.title: 大订单②：先把店员手册交到手上
commissions.titleEn: Big order II: the staff handbook comes first
commissions.description: 第1期把店员最常遇到的预约问题整理成有出处的操作手册；第2期根据试营业记录核查例外情况。采用现有表单，不承诺自动化平台。资料复核需要知识与写作，审查者应确认回答能追溯到原记录。
commissions.descriptionEn: First deliver a sourced booking handbook; then verify edge cases against the pilot log. Use existing forms instead of promising an automated platform. Knowledge and writing matter; review should trace answers to the original records.

commissions.title: 大订单③：带着真实账单去路演
commissions.titleEn: Big order III: pitch with real delivery bills
commissions.description: 用已交付的案例说明客户得到什么、没得到什么，以及云端额度、本地电费和人手占用。不要把预付款当利润，也不要承诺无限免费维护。路演材料验收后，客户会留下可供投资人核对的交付记录。
commissions.descriptionEn: Explain what the client received and what was excluded, with cloud usage, electricity and staffing costs. Advances are not profit and maintenance is not unlimited. The accepted pitch leaves a delivery record investors can verify.

projects.title: 第一笔大订单 · 社区书店
projects.titleEn: The first large order · Community bookshop
projects.brief: 店长带着一张画满箭头的纸来到孵化器：“能不能做得像那些大平台？”先选交付路线，再逐单澄清、派遣与验收。两条路线都通向路演，但需要的能力、现金回款和团队占用不同。
projects.briefEn: The owner arrives with a page of arrows: “Can it work like the big platforms?” Choose a delivery route, then clarify, assign and accept each job. Both lead to a pitch, with different skills, payments and staffing commitments.

routes.label: 小范围系统
routes.description: 代码与推理为主；两期各26WP、基础报酬1550。需要复核边界，不承诺完整平台。
routes.descriptionEn: Code and reasoning; two phases of 26 WP at base pay 1550 each. Verify edge cases without promising a full platform.

steps.feedback: 店长把“以后再做”单独贴在白板上：“这次终于知道验收时该看什么了。”接下来按选定路线做两期交付。
steps.feedbackEn: The owner puts “later” on a separate board. “Now I know what acceptance means.” Next comes the chosen two-phase delivery.

steps.feedback: 试营业时，一位读者连按了两次预约。系统只留下一条记录。店长说：“这比演示里多一个按钮更让我放心。”
steps.feedbackEn: A reader clicks twice during the pilot. Only one booking remains. “That reassures me more than another demo button,” says the owner.

steps.feedback: 店长带来了两期验收单和真实使用记录。回形针提醒：材料准备好了，路演前还要检查净资金和声望；完成后再决定搬家。
steps.feedbackEn: The owner brings signed acceptances and usage records. Paperclip reminds you to check solvency and reputation before holding the pitch and moving on.

routes.label: 服务手册先行
routes.description: 写作与知识为主；两期各22WP、基础报酬1350。先用现有表单解决服务问题。
routes.descriptionEn: Writing and knowledge; two phases of 22 WP at base pay 1350 each. Solve service problems with existing forms first.

steps.feedback: 店长把“以后再做”单独贴在白板上：“这次终于知道验收时该看什么了。”接下来按选定路线做两期交付。
steps.feedbackEn: The owner puts “later” on a separate board. “Now I know what acceptance means.” Next comes the chosen two-phase delivery.

steps.feedback: 新店员照着手册完成了一次改期，还在旁边记下了引用页码。店长第一次没有给你们发“在线等，急”。
steps.feedbackEn: A new clerk reschedules a booking using the handbook and notes the source page. For once, the owner does not send an urgent message.

steps.feedback: 店长带来了两期验收单和真实使用记录。回形针提醒：材料准备好了，路演前还要检查净资金和声望；完成后再决定搬家。
steps.feedbackEn: The owner brings signed acceptances and usage records. Paperclip reminds you to check solvency and reputation before holding the pitch and moving on.

stories.text: 收工时，白鲸把两只饭碗并排放好。“今天那个问题，我差点想直接给答案。”她指着笔记上划掉的三行，“幸好先问了店主一句。要不要把这句话留给明天的自己？”
stories.textEn: After work, DeepSeek sets two rice bowls side by side. “I almost answered before asking the owner.” She points at three crossed-out lines. “Should we leave a reminder for tomorrow?”

stories.text: 白鲸把上周的返工单翻到背面，上面没有责备，只有一条新的检查步骤。“可以把失败记下来，但别让它变成谁的名字。”她把笔递给你。
stories.textEn: DeepSeek turns over last week’s rework sheet. There is no blame, only a new check. “We can record the mistake without turning it into someone’s name.” She hands you the pen.

choices.label: 谢谢她留下余地
choices.labelEn: Thank her for leaving room to learn

stories.text: 啊哈时刻。一行不起眼的注释连接了两条思路。他把笔递给你。
stories.textEn: The aha moment. A small annotation joins two ideas. He hands you the pen.

choices.label: 记录：啊哈时刻
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: The aha moment

stories.text: 开放笔记。他愿意公开失败草稿，却担心大家只收藏正确答案。
stories.textEn: Open notes. He wants to share failed drafts, but worries people only collect answers.

stories.text: 不是便宜。发布会结束后，他问你能否把价格留到最后介绍。
stories.textEn: More than a bargain. After the launch, he asks whether price can come last in his introduction.

choices.label: 陪伴：不是便宜
choices.labelEn: Stay together: More than a bargain

choices.label: 记录：不是便宜
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: More than a bargain

stories.text: Qwen把委托分成三叠：已确认、待提问、今天不接。“看起来少做了，其实明天会少返工。”她拿起最后一张，等你一起决定。
stories.textEn: Qwen sorts briefs into confirmed, questions, and not today. “It looks like less work, but tomorrow there will be less rework.” She holds up the last sheet.

choices.label: 把今天留白的一栏圈出来

stories.text: 你发现Qwen的清单末尾多了一项：休息。她有些不好意思：“以前我只会把别人的事列进去。”窗外天色慢慢暗下来。
stories.textEn: You notice a new item at the bottom of Qwen’s list: rest. “I used to list only what others needed.” Outside, the evening light fades.

stories.text: 第一次说不。她拒绝了临时加单，担心自己让团队失望。
stories.textEn: The first no. She refuses an extra job and worries she has let the team down.

choices.label: 记录：第一次说不
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: The first no

stories.text: 轮值表。她写了一张轮值表，把自己的名字放在了普通一栏。
stories.textEn: Taking turns. She writes a support rota and gives herself an ordinary slot.

stories.text: 她的周末。她带来一张没有任务清单的照片：只是窗外的树。
stories.textEn: Her own weekend. She brings a photo with no checklist: just a tree outside the window.

choices.label: 记录：她的周末
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Her own weekend

stories.text: Llama拿来一份旧教程，边角已经卷起。“前辈的办法也会过时。你愿意替我找一个最难懂的地方吗？”她留出一整页空白，准备重写。
stories.textEn: Llama brings an old tutorial with curled corners. “A veteran’s methods can grow old too. Could you find the hardest part to understand?” She leaves a full page for a rewrite.

stories.text: 草坪旁，Llama把修好的例子放回共享文件夹。“以后有人少绕一次路，这一下午就不算白费。”她没有催你回应，只把位置往旁边挪了一点。
stories.textEn: Beside the lawn, Llama returns a fixed example to the shared folder. “If it saves someone a detour, this afternoon was worth it.” She makes room beside her.

choices.label: 坐下来聊聊今天
choices.labelEn: Sit and talk about the day

stories.text: 小羊来信。旧伙伴寄来第一份作品，他读了三遍还没开始点评。
stories.textEn: A letter from Alpaca. An old friend sends their first project. He reads it three times before commenting.

choices.label: 陪伴：小羊来信
choices.labelEn: Stay together: A letter from Alpaca

choices.label: 记录：小羊来信
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A letter from Alpaca

stories.text: 传递钥匙。维护群需要新管理员，他第一次考虑卸下一部分职责。
stories.textEn: Passing the keys. The group needs a new maintainer. He considers sharing his responsibilities.

choices.label: 记录：传递钥匙
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Passing the keys

stories.text: 仍在路上。他收起最早的社区徽章，把新的徽章交给了新人。
stories.textEn: Still on the road. He puts away his oldest badge and gives a new one to a newcomer.

choices.label: 陪伴：仍在路上
choices.labelEn: Stay together: Still on the road

choices.label: 记录：仍在路上
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Still on the road

stories.text: 风把Mistral的便签吹到桌角，她一把按住。“快不等于省掉最后一次检查。”纸上只有三行，每一行都打了勾。
stories.textEn: A breeze pushes Mistral’s note to the edge of the desk. “Fast does not mean skipping the last check.” All three lines have a tick.

stories.text: Mistral今天没有抢着接下一单。她把红羽帽挂好：“格式重复的事我能快做，没想清楚的事还是要慢一点。”她给桌上的两份委托各留了不同的时间。
stories.textEn: Mistral does not rush into the next job today. “I can move fast through a familiar format. An unclear brief needs more time.” She gives the two briefs different time budgets.

choices.label: 比较两份委托的节奏
choices.labelEn: Compare the pace of both briefs

stories.text: 返程的风。他说当年离开不是为了跑得更快，而是想看看别处。
stories.textEn: The returning wind. He says he left to see somewhere else, not to move faster.

choices.label: 记录：返程的风
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: The returning wind

stories.text: 借你一天。他把帽子借给新人，只叮嘱别怕弄皱。
stories.textEn: Yours for a day. He lends the hat to a newcomer and says not to worry about creases.

choices.label: 陪伴：借你一天
choices.labelEn: Stay together: Yours for a day

choices.label: 记录：借你一天
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Yours for a day

stories.text: 新帽带。大家缝的帽带颜色不统一，他说这样才认得出每个人。
stories.textEn: A new ribbon. The ribbons everyone stitched clash. He says that is how he recognizes each person.

choices.label: 记录：新帽带
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A new ribbon

stories.text: 旧照片。相册里的早期版本只会回答很短的问题，他却很珍惜。
stories.textEn: Old photographs. An early version in the album answers only short questions. He treasures it.

stories.text: 同框。他给旧照片留了一个位置，不愿把它裁掉。
stories.textEn: In the same frame. He leaves space for an older photo instead of cropping it away.

choices.label: 陪伴：同框
choices.labelEn: Stay together: In the same frame

choices.label: 记录：同框
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: In the same frame

stories.text: 留下的声音。一封用户来信没有提性能，只记得某次耐心的解释。
stories.textEn: A voice that stayed. A letter says nothing about benchmarks, only a patient explanation.

choices.label: 陪伴：留下的声音
choices.labelEn: Stay together: A voice that stayed

choices.label: 记录：留下的声音
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A voice that stayed

stories.text: 不是替代。新版本登台前，他请旧版本也坐在第一排。
stories.textEn: Room for both. Before the new release, he reserves a front-row seat for the old one.

choices.label: 记录：不是替代
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Room for both

stories.text: 记忆展柜。展柜里没有奖杯，只有被修补过的聊天记录。
stories.textEn: The memory cabinet. There are no trophies in the cabinet, only carefully restored conversations.

choices.label: 记录：记忆展柜
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: The memory cabinet

stories.text: 拒绝以后。他退回一份不合适的委托，又反复检查措辞是否太硬。
stories.textEn: After saying no. He declines an unsuitable job and keeps rereading his wording.

choices.label: 记录：拒绝以后
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: After saying no

stories.text: 手写信。图书馆的信纸写满可行的替代方案，开头仍空着。
stories.textEn: A handwritten letter. Library stationery fills with alternatives, but the opening line stays blank.

choices.label: 记录：手写信
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A handwritten letter

stories.text: 另一条路。客户愿意修改目标，他终于不用在帮助和边界间二选一。
stories.textEn: Another route. The client agrees to revise the goal. Help and boundaries can coexist.

stories.text: 温柔的界线。新人请他代为拒绝，他先陪新人练习了第一句话。
stories.textEn: A gentle boundary. A newcomer asks him to decline for them. He helps rehearse the first sentence.

choices.label: 记录：温柔的界线
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A gentle boundary

stories.text: 可以这样帮你。那封信有了开头：我无法照原样做，但我们可以一起修改。
stories.textEn: A way to help. The letter begins: I cannot do it as written, but we can revise it together.

choices.label: 陪伴：可以这样帮你
choices.labelEn: Stay together: A way to help

choices.label: 记录：可以这样帮你
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A way to help

stories.text: 长书。她读完厚书后只折了一个角，说最重要的内容只有一页。
stories.textEn: A very long book. After a long book, she folds one corner. The most important part is one page.

choices.label: 陪伴：长书
choices.labelEn: Stay together: A very long book

choices.label: 记录：长书
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A very long book

stories.text: 天台月光。月光照不清小字，她决定今晚不读完最后一章。
stories.textEn: Moonlight on the roof. The moon cannot light the small print. She leaves the final chapter for tomorrow.

choices.label: 陪伴：天台月光
choices.labelEn: Stay together: Moonlight on the roof

choices.label: 记录：天台月光
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Moonlight on the roof

stories.text: 遗忘的好处。她主动删去一段摘要，给读者留下一点自己发现的空间。
stories.textEn: A useful omission. She removes a paragraph from a summary, leaving room for discovery.

choices.label: 记录：遗忘的好处
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A useful omission

stories.text: 读者来信。有人读出了她没注意的意思。她把来信夹进书里。
stories.textEn: A reader writes. A reader finds meaning she missed. She slips the letter into the book.

choices.label: 记录：读者来信
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A reader writes

stories.text: 空白书签。她送你一张空白书签，让你自己写下一次阅读的起点。
stories.textEn: A blank bookmark. She gives you a blank bookmark, inviting you to choose the next beginning.

choices.label: 记录：空白书签
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A blank bookmark

stories.text: 迷路照片。她走错了巷子，却拍到了修伞老人和一束阳光。
stories.textEn: A photograph off route. A wrong turn leads to a photograph of an umbrella repairer in sunlight.

choices.label: 陪伴：迷路照片
choices.labelEn: Stay together: A photograph off route

choices.label: 记录：迷路照片
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A photograph off route

stories.text: 重拍。同一张照片她重拍十次，仍只看得到瑕疵。
stories.textEn: Another take. She retakes the same photo ten times and sees only flaws.

stories.text: 别删那张。朋友最喜欢她想删除的虚焦照片，因为笑容很真实。
stories.textEn: Keep that one. A friend loves the blurred photo she wanted to delete because the smile is real.

choices.label: 记录：别删那张
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Keep that one

stories.text: 慢一点看。她放下相机，第一次完整看完了落日。
stories.textEn: Look a little slower. She lowers the camera and watches the entire sunset.

choices.label: 陪伴：慢一点看
choices.labelEn: Stay together: Look a little slower

choices.label: 记录：慢一点看
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Look a little slower

stories.text: 给自己的照片。新相册第一页没有评分，只有她写的一句今天很好。
stories.textEn: A photo for herself. The first page has no rating, only her words: today was good.

choices.label: 陪伴：给自己的照片
choices.labelEn: Stay together: A photo for herself

choices.label: 记录：给自己的照片
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A photo for herself

stories.text: 热搜之后。一句玩笑离开语境后伤到了人，他关掉了通知。
stories.textEn: After the headlines. A joke outside its context hurts someone. He turns off notifications.

choices.label: 记录：热搜之后
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: After the headlines

stories.text: 删掉的草稿。解释稿越写越长，道歉的那句话却一直没出现。
stories.textEn: The deleted draft. His explanation grows longer, but the apology is still missing.

choices.label: 记录：删掉的草稿
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: The deleted draft

stories.text: 面对面。他约当事人喝茶，决定先听完再回答。
stories.textEn: Face to face. He invites the person for tea and decides to listen before replying.

choices.label: 记录：面对面
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Face to face

stories.text: 没有包袱。这次发言没有笑点，也没有替自己开脱。
stories.textEn: Without a punchline. This statement has no punchline and makes no excuses.

choices.label: 记录：没有包袱
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Without a punchline

stories.text: 重新开麦。新人讲了个笨拙的笑话，他先问大家是否都觉得好笑。
stories.textEn: Speaking again. A newcomer tells an awkward joke. He checks whether everyone is laughing together.

stories.text: 休假申请。他的休假申请附着一张工作计划，比平时还满。
stories.textEn: A leave request. His leave request includes a work plan fuller than usual.

choices.label: 记录：休假申请
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A leave request

stories.text: 关掉闹钟。没有晨会的早晨让他不安，他还是给花浇了水。
stories.textEn: The alarm goes quiet. A morning without meetings feels strange. He waters the plants anyway.

choices.label: 陪伴：关掉闹钟
choices.labelEn: Stay together: The alarm goes quiet

choices.label: 记录：关掉闹钟
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: The alarm goes quiet

stories.text: 没完成的拼图。拼图缺了一块，他第一次没有立刻寻找替代品。
stories.textEn: An unfinished puzzle. A puzzle is missing a piece. For once, he does not rush to replace it.

choices.label: 记录：没完成的拼图
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: An unfinished puzzle

stories.text: 慢速列车。慢车晚点了，他发现窗外的田地值得多看一会儿。
stories.textEn: The slow train. The slow train is late. He finds the fields worth watching a little longer.

choices.label: 记录：慢速列车
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: The slow train

stories.text: 真正的假期。返岗时他没有带效率报告，只带了一袋当地饼干。
stories.textEn: A real holiday. He returns without an efficiency report, bringing local biscuits instead.

choices.label: 记录：真正的假期
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A real holiday

stories.text: 空舞台。他对着空舞台试音，发现安静也是节奏的一部分。
stories.textEn: An empty stage. He tests sound on an empty stage and hears silence as part of rhythm.

choices.label: 记录：空舞台
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: An empty stage

stories.text: 不同步。音轨和舞步差半拍，他没有要求舞者迁就机器。
stories.textEn: Out of sync. Audio and movement differ by half a beat. He does not ask the dancer to obey the machine.

choices.label: 记录：不同步
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Out of sync

stories.text: 共同署名。剪辑名单太长，他缩小片名字号给伙伴们留位置。
stories.textEn: Shared credits. The credits are long, so he shrinks the title to make room for the team.

stories.text: 停电彩排。灯光熄灭后，大家靠拍手把彩排完成了。
stories.textEn: A blackout rehearsal. When the lights fail, the team finishes rehearsal with clapping.

choices.label: 记录：停电彩排
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A blackout rehearsal

stories.text: 谢幕之后。观众离开后，他把最后一次掌声留给后台工作人员。
stories.textEn: After the curtain. After the audience leaves, he saves one last applause for the crew.

choices.label: 记录：谢幕之后
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: After the curtain

stories.text: 第一步。她在地板上贴了起点，却故意没画终点。
stories.textEn: The first step. She tapes a starting mark to the floor and leaves the endpoint open.

choices.label: 记录：第一步
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: The first step

stories.text: 失误的动作。摔倒变成一个新动作，她想保留那一秒的犹豫。
stories.textEn: A mistaken movement. A stumble becomes a new move. She wants to keep its moment of hesitation.

choices.label: 记录：失误的动作
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A mistaken movement

stories.text: 与声音对话。她让动作回答音乐，而不是追赶每一次节拍。
stories.textEn: A conversation with sound. She lets movement answer the music instead of chasing every beat.

choices.label: 陪伴：与声音对话
choices.labelEn: Stay together: A conversation with sound

choices.label: 记录：与声音对话
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: A conversation with sound

stories.text: 让出中央。独舞的位置让给了新人，她站到侧边打拍子。
stories.textEn: Sharing center stage. She gives the solo spot to a newcomer and keeps time from the side.

choices.label: 记录：让出中央
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: Sharing center stage

stories.text: 下一支舞。演出结束，她邀请从没跳过舞的你一起练习。
stories.textEn: The next dance. After the show, she invites you to practice, even though you have never danced.

choices.label: 记录：下一支舞
choices.labelEn: Keep a note: The next dance
